dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fresh indeed. Newly fished from the icy waters, in fact!

dialogues.speaker: Nesterova
dialogues.text: Hahah, you're a funny one. Sorry, I called you a "fresh face" because... Well, I haven't seen many people from outside this estate at all!

dialogues.speaker: Nesterova
dialogues.text: I was born here, and tried to sneak out many times, but I was always caught by my brother and sisters...

dialogues.speaker: Nesterova
dialogues.text: So to be honest, I've always been quite curious...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you unable to leave this mansion freely, then?

dialogues.speaker: Nesterova
dialogues.text: Well, it's possible, albeit with Lady Pavlina's permission... which she hasn't given in a very long time, though...

dialogues.speaker: Nesterova
dialogues.text: Hehe, tell me more tales about the outside world when you have the time, dear guest!

dialogues.speaker: Nesterova
dialogues.text: Haha, alright. See you. Let's chat again if you should find the time, dear guest!
